# Quality Audit

Per-module quality scorecard for the hexagonal modules. Delegate the heavy scan to the `quality-auditor` agent when available; this skill defines what to check and how to score.

## Arguments
- `$ARGUMENTS` — Optional module name (e.g., `Scorecard`, `Editorial`). Omit to audit all.

## Instructions

### 1. Architecture Compliance (per module, via Grep)

- **Domain purity** — no `use Illuminate\` / `use Laravel\` in `modules/<Module>/Domain/`
- **Layer violations** — no `Infrastructure` imports in `modules/<Module>/Application/`
- **Cross-module coupling** — no imports of other modules' Eloquent models (Admin is the allowed exception)
- **Repository contracts** — `Domain/Repository/` are interfaces; Eloquent implementations live in `Infrastructure/Persistence/Eloquent/` as `final readonly class`

### 2. Complexity

- Files >300 lines in `Domain/` or `Application/`
- Long methods (spot-check the largest files)

### 3. Test Coverage Gaps

| Production code | Expected test |
|-----------------|---------------|
| `Domain/Entity/*`, `Domain/ValueObject/*`, `Domain/Service/*` | `tests/Unit/<Module>/...` |
| `Application/Command/*`, `Application/Query/*` handlers | `tests/Unit/<Module>/...` |
| Eloquent repositories | `tests/Integration/<Module>/...` |
| Controllers / HTTP flows | `tests/Feature/<Module>/...` |
| Frontend pages `resources/frontend/src/pages/**/*.tsx` | co-located `.test.tsx` |

**Coverage-excluded — never flag as missing tests:**
- `Infrastructure/Persistence/InMemory/*` (test doubles)
- `Infrastructure/Persistence/Eloquent/Model/*` (thin models)
- `Infrastructure/Http/Controller/*`, `Http/Request/*`, `Http/Resource/*` (thin HTTP layer)
- `Infrastructure/Provider/*` (service providers)

### 4. Dead Code (spot-check)

- Unused imports, interfaces with no implementation, repository methods never called

### 5. Verify

When in doubt, run the linters/tests rather than guessing: `make lint`, `make test-be`.

### 6. Scorecard

```markdown
# Quality Audit Report

## Per-Module Scorecard

| Module | Domain Purity | Layers | Tests | File Size | Score |
|--------|---------------|--------|-------|-----------|-------|

## Issues by Severity
...

## Recommended Actions
1. ...
```

**Scoring**: A (clean) · B (minor: missing tests, large files) · C (moderate: layer violations) · D (critical: domain impurity, cross-module coupling)
